method: Read-only independent artifact checks. Fresh accepted-command replay of the actual product export; recorded DOM and notice-acknowledgement observations compared to actual replay and offline planning. This reviewer does not operate the browser or mutate any game save.

checks.name: fresh QA setup clears map selection
normal-mode restoration clears target and preserves observed baseline
post-campaign file import clears target without game costs or old notices

separateRestoreBoundaryReview.timing: The file import and final normal-mode restoration happened after the uninterrupted campaign finished. They are separate boundary checks, not checkpoint imports during the continuous route.
separateRestoreBoundaryReview.preservationLimit: Normal-mode baseline preservation is an equality check of the recorded visible fields; it does not establish byte-for-byte equality of an unexported normal save.

observationLimits: Counts refer to evidence records and field comparisons, not a claim that every engine intermediate state had a separate UI observation.

Steps 36/37 and 132/133 each commit two engine commands from one escort confirmation. Their evidence is the combined post-action state. The earlier row is therefore compared to the following command state.
Initial manual action rows without DOM, if present, are steps 1 and 2. Their accepted commands are corroborated by the final product export.
The initial setup mission briefing is separate from post-command notification counts.
Recorded dialog text is checked for each expected title, description, and effect, rather than exact full HTML equality.
Fresh replay corroborates accepted commands and resulting state; UI continuity is separately documented by the root browser operator.

This is one uninterrupted QA route using the verification weapon and supplies. Mutually exclusive branches, normal gear balance, all reward equipment combinations, and all viewport sizes are outside this run.
The offline plan predates the UI-only restore selection fix. It is an engine expectation source, not browser verification of the later build.
Save or mode restoration boundary checks are reported separately under BB-011; they do not increase the campaign command or notification counts.
driverErrorsExcludedFromProductBugs: An invalid navigation selector was corrected before execution.
A notice was requested at step 36 although no engine notification existed.
A no-argument REPLACE_UPGRADE initially matched multiple UI controls; the intended no-replacement control was selected.
